outputs.name: Effective Skill Tier
outputs.description: Modeled tier floored and capped at 0-6; Overcharge excluded.

outputs.name: Estimated Skill Health
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE skill-health reference from Skill List!C262:J262 (TU27 workbook). Tier curve follows the retained source cells; Skill Health plus Skill Efficiency adds once, independently of damage, repair and player armor/health. Shield tier includes valid configured armor cores, floored/clamped with Skill Tier to 0-6. Shield-specific Health is added to the source tier pool before the separate general Skill Health factor, a planner interpretation requiring live verification. This is capacity, not current health, mitigation, regeneration or destruction prediction. No skill mods, skill Expertise, Overcharge or combat events. Source values and bonus stacking need live verification.
outputs.formula: 2654490 * max(0, (1 + curve('skill_bulwark_shield_skill_health_tiers', min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier + armor_core_count)))) + shield_health)) * max(0, 1 + effective_skill_health)

outputs.name: Estimated Ordinary Cooldown (s)
outputs.description: Community level-40 ordinary PvE cooldown reference from Skill List!C261:J261 (TU27 workbook). Base 20s, divided by one plus Skill Haste and Skill Efficiency counted once. Only explicitly reviewed tier Skill Haste enters the additive haste pool; dashed entries contribute zero. Nonpositive speed yields zero as an invalid-boundary estimate, not readiness. Excludes charge refill, skill mods, skill Expertise, Overcharge, timers, use/cancellation/destruction, deployment delays and actual resets. Existing conditional reset capability remains separate. Source baselines and stacking require live verification.

outputs.name: Estimated Active Regeneration Reference (HP/s)
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE shield regeneration reference from Skill List!C263:K263 (TU27 workbook). Source baseline multiplied by one plus the reviewed tier percentage; effective shield tier uses Skill Tier plus configured armor cores, floored and capped at six. Active and holstered channels remain separate. No generic Skill Health, Skill Efficiency, repair, duration, installed Expertise or skill-mod scaling is inferred. This source-rate estimate does not simulate current health, actual healing, regeneration events, depletion, destruction, recovery delay, caps or player stats. Existing health and cooldown outputs remain unchanged. Source values and stacking require live-game verification.

outputs.name: Estimated Holstered Regeneration Reference (HP/s)
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE shield regeneration reference from Skill List!C264:K264 (TU27 workbook). Source baseline multiplied by one plus the reviewed tier percentage; effective shield tier uses Skill Tier plus configured armor cores, floored and capped at six. Active and holstered channels remain separate. No generic Skill Health, Skill Efficiency, repair, duration, installed Expertise or skill-mod scaling is inferred. This source-rate estimate does not simulate current health, actual healing, regeneration events, depletion, destruction, recovery delay, caps or player stats. Existing health and cooldown outputs remain unchanged. Source values and stacking require live-game verification.

outputs.name: Effective Skill Tier
outputs.description: Skill Tier clamped to 0-6 for this preview. Overcharge is excluded.

outputs.name: Revive Charges
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE charge/ammunition capacity from Skill List!C137:J137 (TU27 workbook). Integral base plus the reviewed additive tier table, tier floored/clamped to 0-6. Capacity is not current remaining ammo or an assertion of readiness. Player Ammo Capacity, Magazine Size, Skill Efficiency, damage, repair, duration and haste do not scale this quantity. No charge consumption, refill, skill mods, skill Expertise or Overcharge. Source values require live verification.

outputs.name: Estimated Skill Health
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE skill-health reference from Skill List!C140:J140 (TU27 workbook). Tier curve follows the retained source cells; Skill Health plus Skill Efficiency adds once, independently of damage, repair and player armor/health. Armor cores and shield-specific Health do not scale this variant. This is capacity, not current health, mitigation, regeneration or destruction prediction. No skill mods, skill Expertise, Overcharge or combat events. Source values and bonus stacking need live verification.
outputs.formula: 796347 * max(0, (1 + curve('skill_reviver_hive_skill_health_tiers', min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier)))))) * max(0, 1 + effective_skill_health)

outputs.name: Estimated Duration Reference (s)
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE duration reference from Skill List!C139:J139 (TU27 workbook). Source tier duration and Combined Skill Duration (Skill Efficiency once). Legal permanent Nanite duration reductions apply only to reviewed healing variants. A source duration capacity estimate, not time remaining, fuel/ammo consumption, health-based survival, uptime, talent-buff duration or DPS. No skill mods, skill Expertise or Overcharge. Source values and stacking require live verification.

outputs.name: Estimated Range Reference (m)
outputs.description: Community PvE Range reference from Skill List!C138:J138; source base and tier percentages only. No generic Skill Efficiency, player weapon range, Nanite, damage, repair or Status Effects scaling. Reference geometry, not targets acquired, recipients or hit probability. No skill mods, Expertise or Overcharge; live verification required.

outputs.name: Source Refill Speed Baseline (s)
outputs.description: Reviewed community PvE source property from Skill List!C136:J136; exact base and tier table only. All five Hives expose the retained source Refill Speed baseline in seconds. It stays unscaled: the relationship between refill speed, capacity, haste and Hive-specific talents needs review before estimating charge recovery. It is neither current cooldown nor full-empty refill time. Generic Skill Haste/Efficiency, tier, repair, duration and Nanite do not alter this source reference. No mods, Expertise, Overcharge or charge events; live verification required.

outputs.name: Source Revive Armor Base Share (%)
outputs.description: Reviewed community PvE source property from Skill List!C141:J141; exact base and tier table only. Reviver Hive gains integral charge capacity and separate source revive-armor base share and tier-bonus references. The source does not establish whether the tier percentages are additive share points or multiplicative repair bonuses, so no combined revive-armor share is calculated. Repair Skills, Skill Efficiency, player armor, Nanite and incoming repair do not change these source references. No revival, restored armor points, self-revive charge consumption or recipient caps are inferred. Source interpretation requires live verification. Mods, Expertise and Overcharge remain excluded.

outputs.name: Source Revive Armor Tier Bonus (%)
outputs.description: Reviewed community PvE source property from Skill List!C141:J141; exact base and tier table only. Reviver Hive gains integral charge capacity and separate source revive-armor base share and tier-bonus references. The source does not establish whether the tier percentages are additive share points or multiplicative repair bonuses, so no combined revive-armor share is calculated. Repair Skills, Skill Efficiency, player armor, Nanite and incoming repair do not change these source references. No revival, restored armor points, self-revive charge consumption or recipient caps are inferred. Source interpretation requires live verification. Mods, Expertise and Overcharge remain excluded.

assumptions.name: Target Out of Cover
assumptions.description: Whether the selected enemy is out of cover, so Damage to Targets Out of Cover applies to weapon damage in the target estimates. Off by default.

assumptions.name: Practical Hit Rate (%)
assumptions.description: Share of shots that hit, for practical weapon DPS. Starts at 70%; an editable reference, not a measured accuracy.

assumptions.name: Headshots among Hits (%)
assumptions.description: Share of the hits that land on the head, for practical weapon DPS. Starts at 25%.

assumptions.name: Heartbreaker Stacks
assumptions.description: Assumed currently retained Heartstopper stacks (0-100); the cap is 50 without the Max BPM chest host equipped and selected, or 100 with it. Each stack adds 1% Bonus Armor, or 2% with the Cold backpack host equipped and selected; self Bonus Armor does not require target_pulsed=true. Headshot pulse application, hit generation, and stack decay are not simulated.

assumptions.name: Ranger Target Distance (m)
assumptions.description: Assumed distance to the target (0-100m planner bound). Ranger bonuses count completed 4m intervals and Perfect Ranger bonuses count completed 3m intervals; partial intervals do not add damage. The 100m bound is a planner input limit, not a claimed in-game maximum. Ranger's exact interval rounding and live behavior still need in-game validation.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Geometry Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge radius, range and cone-angle references for selected reviewed variants. Does not activate Overcharge or change ordinary outputs. Source geometry only; no area, detection, targets hit, recipients or amplification. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Capacity Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge maximum charges, ammo, deployables, zones or targets for selected reviewed variants. Maximum counts only; no remaining charges, refill time, self-revive consumption, targets hit or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Lifetime Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge deployment, cloud or effect-lifetime references for selected reviewed variants. Source lifetime only; no time remaining, status duration, recipient buff duration, uptime or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Health Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge device, shield, zone or foam health capacity for selected reviewed variants. No current health, survival, damage taken or shield invulnerability. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Utility Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge speed, threat, support properties, shield regeneration, raw Hive haste and Reviver armor bonuses for selected reviewed variants. No combined Hive refill or restored armor, applied recipient buffs, refreshed timers, travel time or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Recovery Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge ordinary cooldown or single-ammo recovery estimates for selected reviewed variants. No Hive refill, charge speed, current timer, full refill, actual readiness or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Enemy Target Profile
assumptions.description: Enemy for target estimates. Profiles group game-file NPC declarations by role, health base and armor base, labelled with the factions that use them most. Named entries are a sample of named bosses, one per main faction, with the mission whose scripts reference them; whether they spawn there with these values, and with which role override, is not established.

assumptions.name: Enemy Group Size
assumptions.description: Number of players the enemy is scaled for.

assumptions.name: Enemy Hit Rate (%)
assumptions.description: Share of the enemy's shots that hit you, for time to armor break. Starts at a flat 50%; Shade-Tech in-game counts found about 70% within 15 m and 30% beyond for a normal enemy.

assumptions.name: Enemies Attacking
assumptions.description: Enemies of the selected target firing at you at once.

assumptions.name: Enemy Firing Time (%)
assumptions.description: Share of the time the enemy spends firing. Enemies fire in bursts, move and reload, with pauses that the game data does not yet describe; testers judge they fire under half the time, so it starts at 50% (G428). 100% is continuous fire.
